source: SBD > PCM Master (Sony PCM-F1/Maxell HG-T120 VHS)

ai_review.summary: Thin, under‑filled soundboard capture despite a praised balanced mix; musical details are scarce.
ai_review.review: The recording is a digital soundboard (dsbd) source that many listeners find thin and lacking the usual reverb, sustain, and impact of a typical 1982 show. While one reviewer rates it poorly for its sonic fullness, another gives it a perfect rating, noting good balance in the mix. No specific performance details are mentioned, so the musical quality remains unclear.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviews give opposite extremes (1★ and 5★); one criticizes recording fullness while the other praises balance, leading to a moderate overall rating with medium confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as thin, lacking reverb and sustain; no impact. One reviewer notes good balance, but overall the mix feels under‑filled compared to other sources.
